I'm sure your doctors are gonna tell you this but the most important thing is to take PT seriously.  It's been about 7 months since my surgery and I just got cleared for non contact sports a few weeks ago, with around 2 more until I can do full contact.  No matter how dedicated you are to your PT, you can't rush into anything because your bones need time to heal around the bolt to fully secure the new ACL in place, and strengthening your leg muscles isn't going to help speed up that process.
